title: Restore generated-artifact refresh dispatch through a trusted pull-request-target bridge

phases.objective: Use a default-branch pull_request_target bridge to dispatch the registered V2 decision workflow for an exact same-repository, non-draft, main-target pull request carrying the explicit generated-artifact-refresh label.

e2e_journeys.entrypoint: A same-repository pull request targeting main is labeled, synchronized, reopened, or marked ready while carrying generated-artifact-refresh.
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The bridge validates immutable PR metadata, dispatches the registered V2 workflow on main with the exact head ref and SHA, and observes a delegated V2 run without checking out candidate code or writing repository contents.
steps: Read pull-request metadata directly from the pull_request_target event.
Require same repository, base main, non-draft state, explicit refresh label, allowed branch prefix, and a 40-character lowercase SHA.
Dispatch governed-generated-artifact-refresh-dispatch-v2.yml on main with target_ref and expected_head_sha.
Observe a new workflow_dispatch run within a bounded window and fail closed otherwise.
assertions: The bridge has actions:write only for delegation and keeps contents and pull requests read-only.
The bridge does not request issue write authority, checkout candidate code, push commits, or invoke the generated-artifact writer directly.
Cross-repository, draft, non-main-target, unlabeled, stale-SHA, protected-ref, and unsupported-prefix candidates do not dispatch.
V2 remains the canonical decision publisher and the only workflow that may delegate to the governed writer.

phases.objective: Retire older unobserved issue-comment bootstrap paths after V3 produces stable run-bound evidence.
Detect duplicate or stale control-plane triggers without broadening writer authority.
The bridge changes repository automation only and has no external canary target.
Production deployment and runtime verification remain outside this control-plane repair.
